content.title: Constrained Evolutionary Search Constitution — Research Budgets, Objective Multi-Metric Harness, and Keep/Discard Discipline with Provenance (stabilization-wave-20260531 drive)
content.summary: Schema-pack governed Research Constitution (page_type=research-constitution) for the Constrained Evolutionary Search Swarm. Defines fixed ResearchBudget parameters, the canonical 5-metric EvaluationScores harness (contradiction_reduction + resilience_lift + experience_layer_coherence + simplicity + future_prediction_power), and the deterministic keep/discard/fork decision rules with full provenance recording. Directly supplies metric_weights and keep_threshold to MultiMetricEvaluationHarness.evaluate() and is consulted by all budgeted HealingFactor/GridEngine/daily_consolidation paths. Self-referential: any proposed evolution of this constitution is itself subject to the harness and budgets it defines.
core_principles: All autonomous research (healing regeneration, daily_consolidation, GridEngine background threads, research-org specialist teams) runs under a fixed ResearchBudget. No open-ended computation. Exhaustion forces immediate harness evaluation and terminal keep/discard/fork decision.

The 5-metric harness is the sole objective, comparable decision surface. overall_goodness is deterministic weighted composite. Constitution may override weights and threshold per-swarm or per-research-thread.

keep = experience genome fork (Genome.fork) + promotion with lineage (provenance.lineage + ImprovementEvent) + KG strengthened_resilience / healed_by edges. discard = provenance note + possible immune/quarantine marker. fork_further = bounded continuation under remaining budget.

Every decision carries complete provenance snapshot (budget consumption, before/after metrics, correlation_id, stabilization_wave, constitution version consulted). Traceable from any living-experience descendant back to originating research thread.
Simplicity is enforced at the harness level: high artifact count or complex provenance lowers score and favors discard or shallow fork.

research_budget_defaults.consumption_tracking: Mandatory record_consumption(tokens, seconds) calls inside healing_executor, run_daily_consolidation_job, and research-org phase steps. is_exhausted() checked before continuation.

five_canonical_metrics.contradiction_reduction: Delta in synthesis contradictions + gap load pre/post. Higher better. Primary signal for diagnosis/proposal quality.
five_canonical_metrics.resilience_lift: Measured post - pre resilience (KG edge weights + fusion_checkpoint post + immune confidence). Minimum 0.04 AND overall >= threshold required for keep. Core success signal.
five_canonical_metrics.experience_layer_coherence: Fusion quality: participating_swarms breadth, citation depth, daily-present signals, role-swarm participation in fusion_checkpoint. Higher = better 'all work together' outcome.
five_canonical_metrics.simplicity: Inverse of artifacts_ingested + new entities + provenance complexity. 1.0 - min(0.75, artifacts/12). Strongly penalizes over-engineering.
five_canonical_metrics.future_prediction_power: Citations + lineage depth + forward graph signals + experience_layer_v3_seed_referenced + predictive utility in subsequent prefer_experience_layer queries. Higher = stronger long-term value.

multi_metric_harness.decision_logic: if overall >= thresh AND resilience_lift >= 0.04: keep_promote_with_lineage elif overall < 0.35 or budget.is_exhausted(): discard_revert else: fork_for_further_experiment

keep_promote_with_lineage.action: Genome.fork(new_version) on target living-experience or research-constitution; record_improvement(description, score_delta=overall_goodness); promotion.submit; emit KG healed_by/regenerated_from/strengthened_resilience edges; ingest as high-signal experience-observation or daily-present
keep_promote_with_lineage.provenance_recorded: EvaluationScores.provenance with full metrics, budget_snapshot, decision, threshold_used, constitution_version, correlation_id, stabilization_wave, timestamp

discard_revert.action: Record provenance_note only. Mark candidate for quarantine or add immune_rule against pattern. No promotion or fork. May emit damage signal for further diagnosis.

fork_for_further_experiment.action: Record experiment under budget. Spawn temp Adversary or new research-org thread if signal warrants. Continue only while budget remains.
fork_for_further_experiment.provenance_recorded: Mid-score snapshot; lineage points to parent experiment for later resolution

keep_discard_discipline_with_provenance.enforcement: Verifier role (or harness in standard path) is the sole gate. HealingFactor/GridEngine/daily jobs must pass budget + harness before any ingest or promotion.

framework.title: Constrained Evolutionary Search Constitution v1.0 — stabilization-wave-20260531
framework.description: Governs all bounded evolutionary search inside the regenerative substrate. Supplies ResearchBudget defaults and harness overrides to MultiMetricEvaluationHarness. Enforces provenance discipline on every keep/discard/fork for experience genome and research-constitution lineages. Machine-readable rules and weights are the exact payload passed to harness.evaluate(research_constitution=...)

integration_points.healing_factor: default_research_budget + evaluation_harness bound in __init__ and for_stabilization_wave; _execute and on_damage_signal pass budget and consult constitution for overrides
integration_points.grid_engine: All background research threads (damage + maintenance + autonomous) run under budget + harness; form_research_org_thread accepts research_budget param
integration_points.multi_metric_evaluation_harness: Primary consumer of this constitution's metric_weights, keep_threshold, and rules for deterministic scoring
integration_points.genome_models: keep always triggers Genome.fork + provenance.lineage + ImprovementEvent with harness scores
integration_points.durable_job_supervisor: All phases (healing, daily_consolidation, research-org) instrumented for budget consumption; exhaustion forces harness decision inside executor
integration_points.knowledge_graph: Every decision emits traceable edges; provenance_note references constitution id + version

framework.self_referential_clause: This constitution was produced by the Research Constitution Architect Swarm under the exact ResearchBudget and harness rules it now codifies (using stabilization-wave-20260531 tuned conservative limits). Any future proposal to relax budgets, reweight metrics, or alter keep logic must itself be submitted as research_evolution_proposal, evaluated by the harness (consulting this version or its fork), and only promoted on keep. The four constitutions in this set were produced as a single bounded research thread and passed internal harness evaluation for coherence + simplicity.
